result.title: Beyond Paired Inputs: Learning to Leverage RGB-T Cross-Modal Relations in Multimodal Large Language Models
result.summary: RGB and thermal infrared (TIR) sensors provide complementary observations, yet their distinct sensing characteristics make effective cross-modal coordination challenging. Although existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process paired RGB-T inputs, they often fail to translate cross-modal relations into effective task-specific decisions, leaving the potential of these relations to improve task performance and robustness largely untapped. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RelMLLM, an RGB-T MLLM that explicitly learns to exploit cross-modal relations in task-specific decision making. It represents modality reliability, the cross-modal relation, and the dominant modality as a verifiable decision state. We derive task-grounded supervision for this state by comparing RGB-only, TIR-only, and paired RGB-T task outcomes. A hierarchical relation-guided reward supervises modality-specific evidence, relation-state prediction, and the final task output, while encouraging consistency across evidence, relation, and decision. We evaluate RelMLLM on natural RGB-T grounding, RGB-T visual question answering, and held-out sensor degradation. RelMLLM improves grounding accuracy and degradation robustness over its Qwen3-VL baselines while preserving performance on general RGB-T reasoning benchmarks. These results demonstrate that effectively exploiting cross-modal relations leads to more accurate and robust RGB-T decisions. Code and model weights are publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RelMLLM，在 RGB-T 多模态大模型中把模态可靠性、跨模态关系与主导模态显式表示为可验证的决策状态，并以比较 RGB-only、TIR-only、成对输入任务结果的层次化关系引导奖励，监督模态证据、关系预测与最终输出的一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该决策状态与模态可靠性判断直接对应 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选和贡献分配问题，其基于任务结果的监督构造与传感器退化鲁棒性评估可供核查，尤其是该状态是否被后续推理真正使用、而非仅作辅助输出。
